name: 司潔妮
objective:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調工程專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service engineering students / professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Course Introduction & Cross-cultural Communication Warm-up 課程介紹、學習策略、跨文化溝通基礎、發音暖身與英語遊戲
Week 2: Introducing Yourself & Exchanging Personal Details 自我介紹、字母拼讀、基數與電話號碼
Week 3: Talking about Dates, Times & Schedules 日期、時間、序數、時刻表閱讀與聽力
Week 4: Identifying Objects & Technical Parts 零件與工具名稱、this/that/these/those、基本物件描述 
Week 5: Describing Size, Color & Quantity 尺寸、顏色、數量表達；物件描述對話練習
Week 6: Tools and Their Functions 工具部位、用途描述、have 句型與現在簡單式
Week 7: Positions, Locations & Occupations 位置介系詞、職業介紹、工作場域對話
Week 8: Listening/Reading Practice 聽力與閱讀技巧整合練習
Week 9: Midterm Exam 期中筆試
Week 10: Describing Movement & Direction 方向副詞、can / can't 表達能力、移動描述
Week 11: Controls, Speed & Operating Instructions 控制裝置、速度單位、imperative + present simple
Week 12: Fluid Systems & Flow 流體系統、進出方向介系詞、流動動詞
Week 13: Circuits & Cause-Effect Relationships 電路詞彙、電學單位、零條件句（If... , ...）
Week 14: Describing Ongoing Actions & Processes 現在進行式、動作描述、拼字規則
Week 15: Materials, Properties & Professional Contact Information 材料屬性、Email/網址唸法、電話應對句型
Week 16: Final Exam 期末筆試

(課程依照學生實際狀況微調)
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          學生分組設計一款以工程英文為主題的教學桌遊
第 17 週聚焦於產品設計 (Design / FAB)：各組提出設計企劃書與具體目標、產出桌遊雛形、撰寫英文遊戲說明書。
第 18 週聚焦於行銷推廣 (Marketing)：各組試玩，並以錄影方式輪流進行英文導覽與產品推薦，運用 AI 工具輔助腳本撰寫與發音校正，學習以英文呈現產品特色、優勢、效益 。

Groups design an engineering-English board game.
- Wk17 (Design/FAB): design proposal, prototype, English manual.
- Wk18 (Marketing): playtest, English pitch video using AI tools; present Features, Advantages, Benefits.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          學生將以英文設計並製作工程英文主題桌遊，運用課堂詞彙與句型；並以 AI 工具輔助撰寫行銷腳本，呈現產品特色、優勢與效益。

Students will design an engineering-English board game using class vocabulary/patterns, then use AI to draft a marketing script presenting its Features, Advantages, and Benefits.

第 17 週 (Design/FAB，週四 15:00 前)：(1) 企劃書 (2) 桌遊雛形 (3) 遊戲說明書。
第 18 週 (Marketing，週四 15:00 前)：試玩 + 英文導覽影片與講稿。

Wk17 (Design/FAB, Thu 15:00): (1) proposal (2) prototype (3) manual.
Wk18 (Marketing, Thu 15:00): playtest + pitch video/script.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Week 17-18 作業合計占 課程成績 (CP) 20%。 

Wk17–18: 20% of CP.

scorePolicy:
* 選修本課程，請務必準時到班上課；第一堂課請勿缺席，若無法到課請事先請假。
* Any student who accumulates FIVE unexcused absences in the semester class will receive a no-credit status. 無故缺席 5 次，即無法獲得本課程學分。

(1) Class Performance (CP), including 課程表現，包括:
 - Midterm Exam / 期中考: 20%
 - Final Exam / 期末考: 20%
 - Class Participation & Activities / 課堂參與及活動: 20%
 - Homework Assignments (W17-18) / 作業: 20%
 - Attendance 出席: 20% (-5% for each absence 無故缺席一堂課 -5%)

(2) School-wide English Proficiency Exam (EPE) 校際英文會考

Overall score 學期科目總分 = 80%(1) 課程 + 20%(2) 會考
materials:
Technical English 1

This course is an English for Specific/Academic Purposes (ESP/EAP) course. All materials, handouts, and slides are in English. At least 70% of classroom instruction and teacher-student interaction is conducted in English.
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
